helmet.title: Welcome to One App
cards.oneApp.title: Welcome to One App
cards.oneApp.body1: Whether it be a tiny single paged dashboard, or a vast multifaceted application, One App can accelerate your development process and facilitate you delivering quality software to your users.
cards.oneApp.body2: Check out our documentation where you can find How To's, common recipes, and FAQ's.
cards.oneDLS.title: On Brand
cards.oneDLS.body1: With a deep collection of css classes, a React Component library, and a brand certified look and feel, DLS super charges your applications development.
cards.oneDLS.body2: Want to comply with the latest Accessibility standards, create a responsive application, and gather meaningful analytics from your users journey? DLS has everything you need.
cards.community.title: Join the Community
cards.community.body1: Head on over to #one-dev where you can ask any questions you have about one app. #one-amex_news will keep you up to date on new release, known issues, and other important announcements.
cards.community.body2: We welcome contributions and hold nothing on principle, so if you have an idea for how our platform can be improved let us know, and together we can build a better web
cards.nextSteps.title: Next Steps
cards.nextSteps.body1: This repo contains some example code, covering Components, I18n, and Unit Testing. Once you have had a look around this example code, you can delete `/src/components/Welcome`, and `/__tests__/components/Welcome` to remove all example code.
